dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Hmm... How was the experience, Honorary Knight?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I think Tres has a knack for this. This challenge should help you understand several key points of surveying...

choices.text: Even a beginner can grasp it with ease!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: W—Well, that's good. Tres is very talented and diligent. If he delivers something that everyone's happy with, that will surely boost his confidence...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: As for Elowen, she may be better at some things than others, but she excels in many areas. It's not an exaggeration to call her an all-rounder.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Especially when it comes to cooking. Everyone who's been to the Reconnaissance Company Camp can't stop raving about it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're making me want to try it.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Then feel free to drop by more often! Once they've finished their surveying exercises, I should have some free time too!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Actually, they weren't the only ones honing their skills this time. I've been revisiting the basics myself. My perspective and experience have evolved, and my current vantage point has actually given me a whole new set of ideas.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Ultimately, I hope everyone finds this experience fruitful.

choices.text: It's clear from your insights, Mika, that you're a true expert in the cartography field!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Ah, I'm far from an expert... I'm just doing what I can, and I hope it's of some value to the team.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: But compared to other things, I do prefer surveying unexplored regions, recording topographical details, and making accurate maps for everyone.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Not long ago, we were also promoting the "Saury-Saury Scout," which is very useful for scouting monsters and surveying the terrain.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Aside from those of us in the Knights of Favonius, even the adventurers have been praising it. The next step for us is to tackle the issue of mass production...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I hope that my experience can help engineers develop more tools like this in the future... That way, surveying would be easier, more accurate, and safer for everyone...

choices.text: I want to try it again!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Sure, if our Honorary Knight found the experience worthwhile, that would be the best encouragement for Tres. Thank you so much for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: There... still seems to be some room for improvement...

choices.text: Are you reviewing the results from the "Surveying and Searching" challenge?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Yeah. During this exchange, Tres wasn't the only one picking up surveying techniques. I've gained quite a few new insights myself...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I suppose this is what the veterans meant when they were saying, "Teaching others also helps you learn..."

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: ...I need to jot these down quickly. Some precious insights are so fleeting... If I don't jot them down now, they're gone for good.

choices.text: Aren't you going to take a break?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: ...Y—Yeah. Once I've processed what I've learned during this period, I'll take a nice, long vacation.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Maybe exploring unfamiliar sights and walking new roads will lead to a whole new perspective on things.
